issue.schema_type: This value has the wrong type.
issue.schema_enum: Choose one of the offered values.

issue.duplicate_id: This identifier is used more than once: {id}
issue.ref_unresolved: This row points to a record that is left out of the scan because of another message.
issue.title_missing: Add the title of this version.
issue.publisher_missing: Add the publisher of this version.
issue.url_invalid: This is not a full web address. Copy the whole link from the address bar; it starts with http or https.
issue.excerpt_too_long: The excerpt has {length} characters; the limit here is {limit}.
issue.news_excerpt_not_allowed: An excerpt of another outlet's news is not kept. Write the fact sentence in your own words instead.
issue.excerpt_not_in_pasted_text: This excerpt is not in the pasted text of the version, word for word.
issue.date_format: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY, or leave it empty.
issue.date_kind_missing: Choose what kind of date this is.
issue.kind_endpoint_mismatch: The two ends of this link do not fit its kind.

form.noVersions: No versions yet. Add the first one.
form.label: Version label
form.labelHint: The stage as the source names it.
form.documentNumberHint: Only when this version has another number than the bill.
form.title: Title
form.languageHint: A language code, for example en or ko.
form.factSentenceHint: One sentence in your own words for what the news item reports. No excerpt is kept.
form.pastedTextHint: Optional. Excerpts are checked against it.
form.noDates: No dates entered. Add only the dates you know.
form.dateHint: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. Leave empty if you do not know it.
form.excerptHint: A short passage copied word for word.
form.newsNoExcerpt: News from another outlet carries no excerpt. Write the fact sentence in the version instead.
form.leftOut: Left out of the scan until the problem is fixed.
form.nothingToScan: Nothing to scan yet. A version needs a title and a publisher before it appears.
form.startHint: Start from a sample, import a JSON file, or type everything in below. Starting or importing replaces what is in the form.
form.importHint: Choose a case file from this computer. It is read here and sent nowhere. Check records inside it are not kept.
form.importDone: The file was loaded into the fields below.
form.importUnusable: This file is not a case Bill X-Ray can read. The form was not changed.
form.compareHint: Choose two texts. The difference between them appears in the scan below at once.
form.compareNeedVersions: Add two versions with pasted text to compare them.
form.compareNeedClauses: Add two clauses with an excerpt to compare them.
form.linksHint: Optional. A link joins two rows of your case. It is drawn once it has an evidence row, and it stays Not verified until the team checks it on the official pages.

linkKindOption.carried: Clause carried into a later version
linkKindOption.not_included: Not found in this final version

form.promiseHint: Fill it in only if the case has a promise. The source is treated as another outlet's article, so no excerpt is kept.
form.promiseStatementHint: In your own words. Do not paste the article's text.
form.promiseDateHint: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. Leave empty if you do not know it.
form.promiseFactSentenceHint: Optional. One sentence in your own words for what the article reports.
form.banner: Entered by you. Bill X-Ray compared the texts. Links stay Not verified until the team checks them on the official pages.
form.bannerCopied: Rows copied unchanged from a sample keep the checks recorded for them; changing a row removes its check.
